I'll start by reading `docker-compose.yml` to find the flaky service and its restart policy.
The `flaky` service restarts because its command always exits with an error, and `restart: always` restarts it every time it exits.

The command at `docker-compose.yml:4` is `sh -c "echo starting; echo 'fatal: missing DATABASE_URL' >&2; exit 3"`. It never reads `DATABASE_URL`. It prints a hard-coded error and exits with status 3. The `DATABASE_URL_HINT` variable on line 7 is only a string, so setting it does nothing. `restart: always` (line 5) restarts the container after any exit, so the cycle repeats.

To stop the loop, either change the command so it actually checks for `DATABASE_URL` and exits only when it's missing, or remove the `restart` policy if this is a one-shot check. I didn't change any files. Also, `API_SECRET` is stored in plain text on line 8, so consider moving it to an env file or a secret.
